risk.ransomware_encrypt: Encryption and irreversible loss of your personal photos, videos, and documents.
risk.ransomware_backup: Attempt to delete automated backups and Windows shadow copies.
risk.ransomware_extortion: Financial ransom demand in cryptocurrency under threat of data leakage.
risk.stealer_passwords: Theft of your credentials, saved passwords, and browser session cookies (Chrome, Firefox, Edge).
risk.stealer_banking: Interception of banking credentials, credit card details, and PayPal / crypto accounts.
risk.stealer_discord: Hijacking of your Discord, Steam, gaming, or social media accounts.
risk.miner_cpu_gpu: Intensive, clandestine use of 100% of your CPU or graphics card.
risk.miner_hardware_damage: Significant hardware overheating, premature component wear, and high electricity draw.
risk.miner_freeze: Severe slowdowns, system freezes, and PC instability.
risk.dropper_secondary: Silent background download of additional viruses or ransomware.
risk.dropper_backdoor: Installation of a backdoor allowing cybercriminals to regain access to your PC.
risk.trojan_takeover: Full remote control of your computer without your consent.
risk.trojan_spyware: Potential surveillance of your screen, webcam, microphone, or keystrokes.
risk.trojan_injection: Injection of malicious code into legitimate Windows processes to bypass security.
risk.trojan_data_loss: Modification or deletion of system files and programs.
risk.caution_unsigned: Unsigned executable: developer identity cannot be authenticated with certainty.
risk.caution_unexpected_behavior: Unusual internal structure or behavior that may cause unexpected effects.
risk.caution_system_change: Potential modifications to Windows configuration or Registry.
risk.safe_no_threat: No harmful impact detected on your files or system.

find.type_mismatch: The extension "{declared}" does not match the real content: {real}. Suspicious disguise.
find.double_ext: Suspicious double extension in the file name (e.g. document.pdf.exe). Deception pattern.
find.entropy_high: Very high global entropy ({value:.2f}/8): encrypted, compressed or packed data.
find.entropy_elevated: Elevated entropy ({value:.2f}/8). Suspicious for uncompressed executables.
find.ransom_strings: {count} ransomware / ransom note string indicator(s) identified.

pe.not_pe: Not a Windows executable: PE analysis not applicable.
pe.parse_failed: Unreadable or corrupted PE structure. Parsing failed.
pe.section_entropy_high: Section "{name}" has very high entropy ({value:.2f}/8) — packed or encrypted code.
pe.section_wx: Section "{name}" is both writable AND executable (W+X) — common in injection.
pe.no_imports: No imported function declared: the executable is likely packed.
pe.downloader_pattern: Download + execution APIs combined: classic dropper behavior.
pe.antidebug_imports: Anti-debugging APIs present (used to resist analysis).
pe.future_timestamp: Compilation date is in the future: {date}. Forged binary.
pe.tls_callbacks: {count} TLS callback(s): code runs before the main entry point.
pe.entry_not_first: Entry point outside the first section — typical of packers.
pe.entry_invalid: Entry point does not fall inside any section — malformed or packed.
pe.overlay_large: Large overlay appended after sections ({mb:.1f} MB) — hidden payload possible.
